nodes.label: Regression tests
nodes.rationale: Pin a fixed bug and name the bug in the test so nobody removes it by mistake.

nodes.label: Testing policy
nodes.rationale: Production behaves differently from the Astro dev server (static assets ignore HTTP range requests), so e2e tests use wrangler dev.

nodes.label: Adoption plan (code changes)
nodes.rationale: Nothing applied yet; keep the Worker name and attach new domain instead of renaming.

nodes.label: Beacon amber #ff9f1c (accent)
nodes.rationale: Amber means we have data here / you can act.

nodes.label: Globe spec
nodes.rationale: No rim, atmosphere or glow, removed on purpose.

nodes.label: Logo concept: globe, day/night line, amber drone
nodes.norm_label: logo concept: globe, day/night line, amber drone
nodes.rationale: The site in one picture: real-country world map, live day/night shading, and a drone meaning 'here is where you can fly'.

nodes.label: Logo usage rules
nodes.rationale: Drone stays over the Atlantic, 18 degree tilt fixed, no glow, no recolour.

nodes.label: Name: Flyable (proposed)
nodes.rationale: Answers the question the site answers ('is it flyable here?') and is not tied to one country; 'Recreational Drones' is generic and hard to protect. Domains/trademark not verified.

nodes.label: Night flight palette
nodes.rationale: Amber is powerful because it is rare: 5% or less Beacon.

nodes.label: Restrictiveness colours (undecided)
nodes.rationale: Must not reuse Beacon; needs colour-blind-safe palette and a non-colour cue.

nodes.label: Tagline: Know before you fly.
nodes.rationale: Names the benefit and carries the message 'check first'; must never become a claim of permission.

nodes.label: Typography (system fonts)
nodes.rationale: Keeps site fast and free of third-party requests.

nodes.label: Test Before Every Commit
nodes.rationale: Catches regressions before they reach main; requires unit, e2e and regression tests.

nodes.label: Country popups (hover preview, click modal)
nodes.rationale: Country info shows on the globe, not a new page; clicking never navigates away.

nodes.label: Day and night shading
nodes.rationale: Shading is decoration, never data about whether flying is allowed.

nodes.label: The globe is the product
nodes.rationale: Keep chrome small; info appears in place.

nodes.label: Light on the wire
nodes.rationale: Must stay cheap to host.

nodes.label: One accent, used for meaning
nodes.rationale: Amber marks 'we have a guide' so covered countries stand out.

nodes.label: Readable first
nodes.rationale: Color is never the only cue.

nodes.label: Trust before flair
nodes.rationale: Every rule shows source and last-verified date; unchecked reads Not yet verified.

nodes.label: Design tokens
nodes.rationale: Single source of truth so colors/sizes are never hard-coded.

nodes.label: Voice
nodes.rationale: Guidance only; never say 'you are allowed to fly here'.

nodes.label: Adding a country
nodes.rationale: Use null for unchecked rules so the page shows Not yet verified instead of a guess.

nodes.label: Colour-code countries by restrictiveness (4 levels)
nodes.rationale: Needs a required restrictiveness field, written criteria and a non-colour cue (DESIGN.md principle 5).

nodes.label: public/favicon.svg (current site favicon: Astro default logo)
nodes.norm_label: public/favicon.svg (current site favicon: astro default logo)
nodes.rationale: Generic Astro placeholder, black/white by color scheme; BRAND.md proposes replacing it with brand/favicon.svg

nodes.label: Deploy on Cloudflare Workers
nodes.rationale: Cloudflare handles deploy; GitHub Actions only checks.

nodes.label: Deep-zoom tiles on R2
nodes.rationale: Workers static assets ignore HTTP range requests and once left the deployed map blank, so the PMTiles file lives in private R2 and the Worker serves ranges.

nodes.label: Mobile guidelines
nodes.rationale: Design for 375px phone first; 44px touch targets; dvh; safe areas.

nodes.label: Known blemish: 50m shapes spill at zoom 6-7
nodes.norm_label: known blemish: 50m shapes spill at zoom 6-7

nodes.label: Map data
nodes.rationale: Everything the map loads comes from this site, so no third-party requests.
